sentence_of_record: NOT-SHOWN; F-FI fires. On known-answer intent corpora the class-pure leaf-mean refit does not reproduce FITSET-FAITHFUL's stage-0 gain: flat within noise on MASSIVE, and worse than as built on CLINC. FITSET-FAITHFUL's sentence keeps 'mostly MMLU-Pro' as a scope limit, and adds: 'on CLINC (C-AN) the same refit lowers fine filing (interval below 0)'. ["Re-estimating the leaf MEANS of S1's anchored trees M-AN (82 leaves) and C-AN (131 leaves) on the TRAIN items of each anchor's declared coarse class; leaves and topology fixed; one draw; qwen3 512". Anchored trees only, with ADDED TRAIN-label use. Never "label-free"; never "a construction with declared fit sets". FI1 CLINC UNDETERMINED under the registered bar, but the refit HURTS: D -0.0264, 95% [-0.0333, -0.0192] (net -176 / 6,672 items), interval wholly below 0. It is not REVERSED only because |D| is below the k-means seed spread 0.0529.]

plain_description.what: Takes trees on intent-classification datasets with known answers (MASSIVE and CLINC) whose top levels follow the declared classes. It re-estimates each leaf's centre using only training items of the matching declared class, keeps the tree shape fixed, and measures fine-level filing accuracy. No calls.
plain_description.why: An earlier refit (FITSET-FAITHFUL) improved filing on MMLU-Pro. This checks whether that gain carries beyond MMLU-Pro.
plain_description.information: A gain here would make the refit a general improvement. No gain limits it to MMLU-Pro. Result: not shown. The refit is flat within noise on MASSIVE and makes filing worse on CLINC. The earlier gain keeps the limit "mostly MMLU-Pro". This applies to label-anchored trees only, one draw, and the refit itself uses training labels, so it is not label-free.
